assets.title: Inventory resource configuration
assets.description: Collect supported resource metadata. Reconcile unsupported types, indexing delay and service-native inventories; this is not an authoritative census by itself.

asset_iam.title: Inventory resource allow policies
asset_iam.description: Search allow-policy bindings in the selected project. Does not resolve group membership, ancestor inheritance, deny policies, principal access boundaries or all data-plane ACLs.

org_assets.title: Reconcile organization project inventory
org_assets.description: Reconcile organization project inventory; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

org_policies.title: List project organization-policy overrides

keys.description: List cryptographic key configuration; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

sinks.title: Read project logging sinks
sinks.description: Read project logging sinks; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

org_sinks.description: Read organization aggregated logging sinks; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

exclusions.title: Read sink exclusion filters
exclusions.description: Read exclusions embedded in sink configuration, including the _Default sink. The GA CLI does not expose a logging exclusions list command.

log_buckets.title: Read regional log bucket retention
log_buckets.description: Read regional log bucket retention; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

log_metrics.title: List logs-based metrics
log_metrics.description: List logs-based metrics; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

audit_logs.title: Sample audit events within the approved window
audit_logs.description: Bounded metadata and payload sample of audit events in an explicit UTC window. Always classified Sampled, or Truncated at the limit; never proof of full event coverage. Logs can contain sensitive values.

scc.title: Read Security Command Center findings
scc.description: Read findings for the selected organization and SCC location. Availability depends on activation, location, tier and permissions; an empty response is not a clean bill of health.

repositories.title: List Artifact Registry repositories
repositories.description: List Artifact Registry repositories; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

build_triggers.title: Read Cloud Build triggers
build_triggers.description: Read Cloud Build triggers; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

builds.title: Sample existing Cloud Build execution metadata
builds.description: Bounded sample of the most recent 100 builds; statuses and provenance links require review. Reaching 100 is marked Truncated; fewer is still Sampled.

deploy.title: Read Cloud Deploy delivery pipelines
deploy.description: Read Cloud Deploy delivery pipelines; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

binary.title: Read Binary Authorization admission policy
binary.description: Despite the verb export, this returns the existing policy to stdout; no --destination or cloud write is used.

ai_endpoints.title: List Vertex AI endpoints
ai_endpoints.description: List Vertex AI endpoints; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

ai_models.title: List Vertex AI model metadata
ai_models.description: List Vertex AI model metadata; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

ai_datasets.title: Inventory supported Vertex AI dataset metadata
ai_datasets.description: Use Cloud Asset Inventory for supported Vertex AI dataset resources; reconcile with owner-provided native dataset exports and unsupported generative data stores.

billing_link.title: Read project billing association
billing_link.description: Read project billing association; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.

budgets.title: List explicitly approved billing budgets
budgets.description: Billing accounts are separate authorization scopes, not proven by project ancestry. Only explicitly approved billing account IDs are read.

project_info.title: Read Compute project quotas and metadata
project_info.description: Read Compute project quotas and metadata; returns configuration metadata for auditor review.
